evidence.name: Screen field: Line spacing in the field
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Line spacing in the field" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Line spacing in the field
sections.description: Sets the vertical gap between lines of typed text (0-50pt, default 18). It only shows when an answer wraps onto multiple lines, so for normal single-line questions leave it at the default. Adjust it only if you've allowed long, multi-line responses and they feel too cramped or too loose.
